digest.component_or_area: plan review: acceptance criteria satisfiability and child-coverage audit
propositions: A new 1-TURN criterion ac-satisfiability (facet: coherence) must own detection of mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations within a single ticket, covering three contradiction shapes: universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality.

The sibling roster passed to G3 must carry each child's acceptance-criteria items extracted via evaluate_plan_clarity().ac_items, not only ids and titles, to enable the audit to test whether siblings cover parent criteria.

The sibling roster building expression duplicated across pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, and eval_solver.py must be consolidated into a single shared build_sibling_roster helper in pass1.py to prevent divergence between production and eval harnesses.

The rendered roster must place each child's acceptance-criteria items indented beneath its - <id>: <title> line, with children lacking parseable AC keeping their line alone, and must be sent once in the system prompt prefix rather than repeated per-pairing instruction.
The parent_tokens prefix estimate must include the roster token cost to correctly feed container bin-packing and the warm-then-fan-out caching gate, since the roster is now part of the stable prefix.

G3's rubric must cite the roster's acceptance criteria when instructing the reviewer to test no-sibling-covers-it, and G3's default_posture and block_threshold must remain unchanged pending dogfooding data.
